content: भूयिष्ठ {%a.%} [अतिशयेन बहु इष्ठन् भ्वादेशे युक् च] .²1 Most, most numerous or abundant. .²2 Most important, principal, chief. .²3 Very great or large, very much, much, many, numerous. .²4 Chiefly or for the most part composed of, mostly composed or consisting of, chiefly filled with or characterized by (at the end of <ab>com.</ab>); अभिरूपभूयिष्ठा परिषद् <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; शूल्यमांसभूयिष्ठ आहारोऽश्यते <ls>Ś. 2</ls>; राष्ट्रेषु कतमत्सुपुरुषभूयिष्ठम् <ls>Dk.</ls>; शिल्पदारिकाभूयिष्ठं परिजनम् <ls>M. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 70</ls>. .²5 Almost, mostly, nearly all (usually after a past passive participle); अये अदितभूयिष्ठ एष तपनः <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; निर्वाणभूयिष्ठमथास्य वीर्यम् <ls>Ku. 3. 52</ls>; <ls>V. 1. 8</ls>. .{@-ष्ठम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 For the most part, mostly; भूयिष्ठमन्यविषया न तु दृष्टिरस्याः <ls>Ś. 1. 30</ls>. .²2 Exceedingly, very much, in the highest degree; भूयिष्ठं भव दक्षिणा परिजने <ls>Ś. 4. 18</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 14</ls>.
